title: The Little Cloud Who Found Her Voice
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A little cloud who is afraid to speak discovers that your voice matters — speak up with kindness and courage.
long_description: Puff is a little cloud who is afraid to speak. She longs to be loud like all the other clouds. When she helps a sparrow feel heard, Puff discovers a wonderful secret: your voice matters — speak up with kindness and courage. A gentle bedtime story about self-expression, kindness, and finding your own voice.
moral_lesson: Your voice matters — speak up with kindness and courage.
